observed_problem: The connected GitHub commit-workflow reader filters to pull-request-triggered runs, so post-merge push workflows can be healthy while remaining invisible to terminal agents.
root_cause: Production evidence existed only inside push workflow runs and uploaded artifacts; there was no connector-readable projection attached directly to the merge commit.
structural_fix: Project Production Source Snapshot lifecycle to commit status production/source-snapshot.
Project Production Release Readback lifecycle to commit status production/release-readback.
Bind every status to the exact GITHUB_SHA and canonical Actions run target URL.
Keep Netlify release identity and functional readback as authority; commit status is only an observable projection.
prevention: Terminal live checks must prefer combined commit statuses over workflow-list polling.
Missing required production status is fail-closed and cannot be replaced by crawler freshness.
Regression test statically enforces statuses: write, stable contexts and terminal always() publication.
